rationale: C07 provides a concrete and material template for the child: both concern Oahu lands ceded by the Republic of Hawaii, previously reserved for United States military purposes, no longer needed for those purposes, and restored to the Territory of Hawaii. Their recitals and operative clauses follow essentially the same sequence and use unusually close language. C25 and C13 share substantial machinery and phrasing, but C25 adds a title-transfer mechanism and C13 concerns a different island and uses a less closely matched operative formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: certain lands of Aiea, Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, which form a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750, were reserved for military purposes of the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: certain lands known as Round Top Military Reservation and rights-of-way thereto, located at Honolulu, Island Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, which form a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750, were reserved for military purposes of the United States
shared_material.explanation: The geographic, historical, and legal recital is closely parallel and includes the same distinctive Hawaiian cession language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: certain parcels of such lands are no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such lands are no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: The same factual predicate and public-interest conclusion lead to restoration to Hawaii.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The possession, use, and control of the following-described parcels of land comprising parts of the Aiea Military Reservation, Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described tract of land compromising the round Top Military Reservation and the rights-of-way thereto, located on the Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Both operative provisions identify described portions of an Oahu military reservation and employ the same restoration-to-jurisdiction mechanism before metes-and-bounds descriptions.
